name: v0.3.26 — store logo fills the circle · receipt hero cleaned up
releaseNotes:
• Store logos now fill their circle edge-to-edge (BoxFit.cover + no inner padding). Office Depot, Costco, etc. no longer show a tiny mark inside a big white ring.
• Receipt detail hero stripped of decorative avocado/flower emojis — they read as misaligned 'stars' floating around the logo. The centered store logo + gradient is the focal hierarchy now.
